svg.text: CRITICAL ARCHITECTURAL ENGINEERING DETAILS (APPLIED ACROSS ALL 4 DESIGNS)
DETAIL A: VC-E SEM SLAB ISOLATION
• Slab-on-Grade ONLY (Y = 0.0m) — NEVER suspended 2F/3F.
• 4.0 x 4.0 x 1.0m reinforced concrete inertia block.
• 38mm saw-cut neoprene perimeter joint decouples floor.
• Mu-metal wall shield + 3-axis active Helmholtz coil (<= 0.5 mG).
• NC-35 laminar displacement diffuser (+/- 0.5 C/hr stability).
• Scroll & turbo pumps exiled to STC-55 chase behind wall.
DETAIL B: COLD STORAGE CHAIN SEPARATION
• Separated >= 10-31m from SEM (plus exterior chiller pad).
• Houses Walk-In +4C, Walk-In -20C, TSX2305GA & TSX60086A (-80C).
• R-30 vapor-tight panels + frost-free heated vestibule airlock.
• Dual Red ATS Emergency Generator receptacles + LN2 backup.
• Ceiling O2 depletion strobe/alarm (19.5% interlock cutoff).
• 25 ACH independent heat-rejection HVAC loop.
DETAIL C: CAFE / BAKERY vs LAB CODE LOCK
• Separate Type I/II stone-deck oven exhaust hood & MAU.
• Bakery stack offset >= 12m downwind from lab air intakes.
• Independent grease interceptor sanitary waste line.
• Badge-controlled acoustic glass vestibule locks wet labs.
• Glass bakehouse walls showcase pastry science cleanly.
• Shared pre-function coffee service straight into Auditorium.

g.text: 2-Story CLT Spine + Ground Metrology + Crystal Drum
Wet Labs & Rear High-Bay 100% untouched; only East wing built to 2F.
1. RECOMMENDED FLAGSHIP: Preserves active Front & Rear labs undisturbed.
2. All 10 ChemMate Tier classrooms unified along 1 sunlit Floor 2 CLT deck.
3. West Cold Vault (-38..-22) & NW SEM (+12..+27.5) cut by 10m stock buffer.
4. Glass Bakehouse & Roastery spill smoothly onto Garden Pergola & Drum.
5. Detached Crystal Drum Auditorium gives instant iconic campus identity.
